page.js_required: JavaScript is required to use this app.
page.expired.title: Access Expired
page.expired.body: This guest session has ended or the link is no longer valid.
page.expired.used_body: This link could only be used a limited number of times, and it has been.
page.pin.title: Enter PIN
page.pin.body: This link is PIN-protected. Enter the PIN you were given to continue.
page.pin.label: PIN
page.pin.error_rate_limited: Too many attempts — please wait a minute and try again.
page.pin.error_link_retired: This link no longer skips the PIN. Enter the PIN to continue.
page.device_claim.title: Use this device?
page.device_claim.body: This link works on one device only. Continue on the phone and browser you will use during your stay — once you do, other devices can no longer open it.
page.device_claim.chat_app_html: Opened this from a chat app? Some apps show links in a built-in browser, which counts as a separate device. Choose Open in browser first, then continue there.
page.device_refused.title: Link in use on another device
page.device_refused.body: This link only works on the device that opened it first.
page.device_refused.same_device: If that was you, open the link there — in the same browser. Links opened from a chat app sometimes land in the app's own built-in browser, which counts as a different device.
page.device_refused.reset: If not, the person who shared it can reset the device lock.
page.install.title: Install as App
install.ios_html: Tap {icon} then "Add to Home Screen" for the best experience.
install.android_html: Tap {icon} then "Install app" or "Add to Home Screen".
